rationale: The historical 8.7 agent table names Essentials and Premier; 8.7.1 release notes identify Premier and say enabled for eligible users. The 8.8 agent table names both Cloud editions with paired SOAR. Its specific Connector Builder guide requires Platform 10.1+, SOAR Cloud, and edit permissions for apps and assets. The later row does not rewrite 8.7 entitlement.

audiences: Readers comparing documented ES deployment and edition scope
exclusions: The reviewed scope does not establish unlisted compatibility, customer enablement, entitlement or authorization.
